name: REFUGE: Retinal Fundus Glaucoma Challenge Dataset
description: REFUGE (Retinal Fundus Glaucoma Challenge) is an authoritative benchmark for evaluating automated methods for glaucoma assessment and anatomical structure segmentation from color fundus photographs. Sourced from the Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center (ZOC) in China and published in Medical Image Analysis, the dataset includes 1,200 color fundus images divided equally into 400 training, 400 validation, and 400 testing samples acquired across two different fundus cameras (Zeiss Visucam and Canon CR-2). Each image features image-level clinical glaucoma diagnostic labels, pixel-level ground-truth segmentations of the optic disc and optic cup for cup-to-disc ratio calculation, and precise fovea center coordinate locations.
